_comment: keel MCP server registration for Cursor. Cursor loads MCP config from ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global) or .cursor/mcp.json (project) — see https://cursor.com/docs/mcp. The structure is {mcpServers: {<name>: {command, args, env}}}. Cursor resolves 'keel' on PATH; the keel installer places the binary at ~/.claude/keel (unix) or ~/.claude/keel.exe (win32) and on PATH. There is no alwaysLoad equivalent — Cursor loads MCP servers on demand; enable/disable is via the Cursor sidebar Customize menu. The keel installer merges the 'keel' entry into your existing mcp.json (never clobbers other servers) and uninstall removes only the 'keel' entry.
